tools.name: get_account_profile
tools.description: Check which eoidata account is connected and whether it currently has an active VIP reading membership. Login is required; this does not expose personal profile fields.

tools.name: get_data_catalog
tools.description: Describe the datasets and boundaries available from eoidata.com without returning detailed data.

tools.name: request_new_data
tools.description: Submit any unmet data need directly to the eoidata product team. No login, VIP membership or product submission quota is required. Include what data is needed and how the Agent would use it.

tools.name: get_eoi_snapshot
tools.description: Return bounded aggregate submitted, invited and lodged counts plus score ranges. Free accounts can query any single occupation for the latest exact pathway; VIP unlocks historical and broader scope.

tools.name: get_eoi_history
tools.description: Return up to 24 months of aggregate submitted, invited and lodged history for optional visa, state or occupation filters. VIP required.

tools.name: get_score_distribution
tools.description: Return aggregate counts by SkillSelect score for one status and a bounded published scope. VIP required.

tools.name: rank_occupations
tools.description: Return only the top 20 occupations by submitted EOI count for a published month and optional visa/state filters. No pagination or bulk export. VIP required.

tools.name: get_related_occupations
tools.description: Return at most six occupations related by ANZSCO unit or minor group, with aggregate submitted counts. VIP required.

tools.name: get_pathway_overview
tools.description: Compare the published visa and state pathways for one occupation in one month using aggregate counts and score summaries. VIP required.

tools.name: compare_occupations
tools.description: Compare aggregate EOI snapshot counts for two to five occupations in the same scope. VIP required.

tools.name: compare_pathways
tools.description: Compare two to five visa/state pathways for one occupation using aggregate snapshot counts. VIP required.

tools.name: get_score_position
tools.description: Return the aggregate number of submitted EOIs at or above a score in one pathway. Free accounts can query any single occupation in the latest exact pathway.

tools.name: get_candidate_profile
tools.description: Return one aggregate profile dimension for submitted or invited EOIs in one occupation pathway. VIP required.

tools.name: get_invitation_rounds
tools.description: Return up to 12 published invitation rounds and aggregate visa outcomes. VIP required.

tools.name: get_occupation_invitation_cutoffs
tools.description: Search published occupation invitation cutoff observations. Free accounts get the latest matching observation for any one occupation; VIP gets up to 50 results.

tools.name: get_state_nomination_progress
tools.description: Return the latest published aggregate state nomination progress, optionally filtered by state or visa subclass. VIP required.

tools.name: get_processing_times
tools.description: Return existing eoidata aggregate invite-to-lodge and lodge-to-close duration statistics. Free accounts get the latest summary for any one occupation and exact pathway; VIP unlocks the full breakdown.

tools.name: get_grant_profile
tools.description: Return the existing aggregate closed-EOI lodged-month and score profile for one exact pathway. VIP required.

tools.name: search_occupations
tools.description: Find up to 10 occupations by ANZSCO code or occupation name. A non-empty query is required; this tool cannot enumerate the full catalog.

tools.name: get_available_scope
tools.description: List the currently available EOI months, visas, states and statuses so another query can stay within published scope.

tools.name: get_latest_overview
tools.description: Return the latest EOI snapshot month, official invitation round date, processing data publication and coverage counts.
